common.lumendeck-couldn't-reach-its-rust-engine: LumenDeck couldn't reach its Rust engine. Make sure the app wasn't closed and try again.
common.dark-wallpaper-tones-and-dim-colors-are-: Dark wallpaper tones and dim colors are lifted (light accents deepened in light theme) until they read clearly on the dashboard. Hardware lighting is never affected — this only changes the interface accent.
common.system-follows-your-windows-display-lang: System follows your Windows display language.
common.true-black-surfaces-in-dark-theme-oled-p: True-black surfaces in dark theme — OLED pixels switch fully off, saving power and making the accent color pop. No effect in light theme.
common.sync-windows-accent-color-to-wallpaper: Sync Windows accent color to wallpaper
common.the-taskbar-start-menu-and-window-highli: The taskbar, Start menu and window highlights shift tone with your wallpaper's dominant color. Your original accent is remembered and restored when this is turned off.
common.also-apply-wallpaper-changes-to-the-wind: Also apply wallpaper changes to the Windows lock screen. Off by default, so you can keep a personal lock image while your desktop stays dynamic.
common.start-lumendeck-with-windows-so-your-lig: Start LumenDeck with Windows so your lights follow your screen from the boot. Starts in the notification area — open the dashboard from the tray icon.
common.with-this-off-logging-in-gives-you-a-cle: With this off, logging in gives you a clean desktop: LumenDeck applies your wallpaper and lights in the background and waits in the tray. Turn it on and the dashboard opens alongside the rest of your startup apps.
common.both-keep-the-wallpaper-and-lighting-run: Both keep the wallpaper and lighting running. Tray hides the window entirely — reopen it with a left-click on the tray icon.
common.stops-wallpaper-playback-while-the-lapto: Stops wallpaper playback while the laptop is unplugged to save power.
common.pause-when-a-fullscreen-app-is-active: Pause when a fullscreen app is active
common.stops-the-wallpaper-while-something-else: Stops the wallpaper while something else has the screen, so a game or a video is not competing with it.
common.capture-the-whole-look-wallpaper-per-mon: Capture the whole look — wallpaper, per-monitor overrides, lighting mode and colors, and the stickers on screen — and recall it any time with one click. Great for day/night, gaming, or streaming setups.
common.no-profiles-yet-set-up-a-look-you-like-t: No profiles yet. Set up a look you like, then capture it above.
common.fallback-for-machines-whose-gpu-video-de: Fallback for machines whose GPU video decoder glitches. Uses more CPU and may stutter on 4K wallpapers. Takes effect after restarting LumenDeck.
common.are-picked-up-automatically-within-a-few: are picked up automatically within a few seconds. Use this if you want to force it right now.
common.lumendeck-live-wallpapers-ambient-lighti: LumenDeck — live wallpapers, ambient lighting, and system theming in one place.
common.the-guide-takes-over-the-window-your-cur: The guide takes over the window. Your current setup stays exactly as it is — you can walk away at any point.
common.replay-the-first-run-guide-pick-a-wallpa: Replay the first-run guide — pick a wallpaper, import media, set up lighting and autostart.
common.deletes-your-settings-the-wallpaper-vaul: Deletes your settings, the wallpaper vault, stickers and cached thumbnails, then closes the app. Your media files are not touched. This cannot be undone.
common.wiping-removes-every-setting-your-wallpa: Wiping removes every setting, your wallpaper vault and your stickers, then closes the app. Your media files on disk stay untouched. Quitting just closes it — the wallpaper and lighting stop with it.
common.connected-but-no-devices-reported-yet: Connected, but no devices reported yet.
common.start-openrgb-then-refresh-from-the-ligh: Start OpenRGB, then refresh from the Lighting tab.
common.engine-off-flip-the-switch-to-wake-your-: engine off — flip the switch to wake your lights
common.connect-openrgb-to-see-live-colors: Connect OpenRGB to see live colors
common.with-the-sdk-server-enabled-settings-ser: with the SDK server enabled (Settings → Server → Start). It listens on port 6742 by default.
common.automatically-turn-off-rgb-after-a-perio: Automatically turn off RGB after a period of no keyboard or mouse activity.
common.pulse-every-device-once-when-the-os-medi: Pulse every device once when the OS media session starts a new track (Spotify, browsers, anything the media flyout sees).
common.the-dominant-on-screen-tone-so-the-light: — the dominant on-screen tone — so the lights match what you're watching. Volume drives brightness; beats pulse the strip.
common.draw-zones-on-the-wallpaper-tab-each-zon: Draw zones on the Wallpaper tab — each zone can be mapped to devices there.
common.click-anywhere-on-the-desktop-to-place-s: Click anywhere on the desktop to place · scroll to resize · right-click or ESC-style cancel to abort
common.drag-to-move-edges-corners-to-resize-rig: Drag to move · edges/corners to resize · right-click deletes · arrows nudge the selected card · auto-exits after 5 min idle
common.stickers-draw-into-the-wallpaper-itself-: Stickers draw into the wallpaper itself — no extra windows — and follow it across monitors.
common.every-wallpaper-layer-sticker-appears-on: Every wallpaper-layer sticker appears on each display at the same relative position. Off: stickers render only where you placed them.
common.snap-sticker-edges-to-other-stickers-and: Snap sticker edges to other stickers and monitor edges & centers (amber lines).
common.quantize-positions-to-a-grid-while-dragg: Quantize positions to a grid while dragging.
common.alignment-guides-win-over-the-grid-the-g: Alignment guides win over the grid: the grid applies only where no guide matched.
common.a-flat-background-detected-from-the-bord: A flat background detected from the borders is made transparent. GIFs are reprocessed frame-by-frame as transparent APNGs; originals stay untouched.
common.add-an-image-gif-or-short-video-and-clic: Add an image, GIF or short video and click once on the desktop to land it.
common.float-above-every-application-window-ins: Float above every application window instead of the wallpaper layer.
common.show-the-hex-code-beside-each-colour-swa: Show the #RRGGBB code beside each colour swatch. The swatches themselves always show the colour.
common.drop-file-or-folder-to-import: Drop file or folder to import
common.videos-images-and-folders-become-vault-c: videos, images and folders become vault cards
common.or-drop-files-and-folders-anywhere-in-th: …or drop files and folders anywhere in the vault
common.no-collections-yet-create-one-with-the-i: No collections yet — create one with the + in the tab bar.
common.add-a-video-or-image-or-drop-files-and-f: Add a video or image, or drop files and folders here — everything stays in the vault and one click applies it to every display.
common.rotate-wallpapers-automatically-shuffle-: Rotate wallpapers automatically: shuffle a collection on an interval, with optional time-of-day rules that swap the pool (e.g. dark shader at night, videos by day). One playlist runs at a time.
common.no-playlists-yet-create-one-and-pick-a-c: No playlists yet — create one and pick a collection to shuffle.
common.without-rules-the-playlist-shuffles-one-: Without rules the playlist shuffles one pool all day.
common.auto-fills-the-screen-and-crops-only-whe: Auto fills the screen and crops only when shapes are similar; Contain letterboxes; Stretch ignores aspect.
common.renders-the-configured-source-behind-you: Renders the configured source behind your icons on every display.
common.each-display-gets-its-own-wallpaper-wind: Each display gets its own wallpaper window sized to its exact resolution. Hover a vault tile to apply it to
common.or-just-one-tiles-show-which-displays-th: or just one — tiles show which displays they're running on.
common.each-zone-is-a-rectangle-of-the-wallpape: Each zone is a rectangle of the wallpaper (normalized 0–1). In
common.mode-devices-receive-the-average-color-o: mode, devices receive the average color of their mapped zones.
common.no-zones-yet-add-one-then-map-devices-to: No zones yet — add one, then map devices to it.
common.direct-link-to-an-mp4-webm-video-or-png-: Direct link to an mp4/webm video or png/jpg/webp/gif image (max 200 MB). It is downloaded into your vault.
common.development-build-local-changes-not-a-re: Development build — local changes, not a release
common.dev-badge-tooltip: Development build from commit {{id}}. Local changes may not match any release.
common.pick-a-color-from-the-screen: Pick a color from the screen
common.follow-system-tracks-your-windows-light-: Follow system tracks your Windows light or dark setting and switches with it.
common.{n}-devices-are-muted-muted-hardware-kee: {{n}} devices are muted. Muted hardware keeps its last color; the engine just stops writing to it.
common.nothing-in-this-view-is-called: Nothing in this view is called “{{query}}”.
common.shuffle-unavailable: Shuffle not available in this app
common.repeat-unavailable: Repeat not available in this app
common.display-reset-to-the-global-wallpaper: Display reset to the global wallpaper
common.attach-this-file-when-you-report-a-probl: Attach this file when you report a problem — it holds the last few hours of activity, rotated once it gets large.
common.dev-build-no-updates: Dev build — update checks are disabled.
common.bundle-{bundle}-running-binary-{running}: Bundle {{bundle}}, running binary {{running}} — other windows may be running older code.
common.dev-facts-unavailable: Build details could not be read — the backend is probably older than this window.
common.profile-name-taken-{name}: There is already a profile called “{{name}}”.
common.keys-released-switch-off: Keys released while global hotkeys are off. Your combos are kept — turn the switch back on in Settings.
common.no-global-hotkeys-yet-set-them-up: No global keys bound. LumenDeck never grabs a key you did not ask for — pick an action and press a combo in Settings.
common.reading-is-stale-the-sampler-stopped: Last reading — the sampler has stopped updating
common.spikes-here-usually-mean-the-wallpaper-o: Spikes here usually mean the wallpaper or the lighting, not LumenDeck idling. A low frame rate with a flat line below means the machine is not the cause.

palette.this-deletes-all-lumendeck-data-settings:
This deletes ALL LumenDeck data (settings, wallpaper vault, stickers, cached thumbnails) and closes the app. Your media files are not touched. This cannot be undone.

Type WIPE to confirm:

lighting.hint-zone: Map regions of the wallpaper to devices
lighting.hint-wave: Rainbow gradient marching around the device
lighting.hint-audio: LEDs pulse to system audio beat

hotkeys.not-active-this-combo-is-taken-so-the-ke: Not active — this combo is taken, so the key does nothing. Another app may already own it; pick a different one.
hotkeys.already-used-by-another-action-the-first: Already used by another action — the first one bound wins.
hotkeys.blink-the-keys-when-a-hotkey-fires: Blink the keys when a hotkey fires
hotkeys.flash-the-keyboard-backlight-so-you-can-: Flash the keyboard backlight so you can tell a combo registered while you are looking at the wallpaper instead of the tray. Older keyboards expose only whole-backlight zones, so this flashes every key rather than just the ones you pressed.
hotkeys.no-keys-are-taken-right-now-lumendeck-ne: No keys are taken right now — LumenDeck never grabs a key you did not ask for. Pick an action, press
hotkeys.then-press-the-combo-they-keep-working-w: , then press the combo. They keep working while the dashboard is closed.
hotkeys.combos-need-a-modifier-ctrl-alt-shift-or: Combos need a modifier (Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win) or an F1-F24 key, so a binding can never swallow the key you are typing. If another app already owns a combo, LumenDeck says so instead of failing quietly.
hotkeys.toggleDashboard-description: Bring the dashboard up, or get it out of the way when it is already focused.
hotkeys.playPause-description: Toggles whatever the current media session is playing.
hotkeys.nextTrack-description: Skips forward in the current media session.
hotkeys.prevTrack-description: Skips back in the current media session.
hotkeys.volumeUp-description: Raises the system volume by 5%, unmuting first if needed.
hotkeys.toggleWallpaper-description: Freezes the live wallpaper without stopping the lighting.
hotkeys.cycleLightingMode-description: Walks the modes in the same order as the tray menu.
hotkeys.nextWallpaper-description: Steps to the next vault entry on every display. Clears per-display overrides so the change is visible.
hotkeys.bound-actions-description: {{n}} of {{total}} actions are bound. Turning this off releases every key immediately — your combos are kept, and the tray menu has the same switch if a binding ever misbehaves.
hotkeys.no-bindings-yet-description: Master switch for the keys below. Nothing is bound yet, so there is nothing to turn off.
hotkeys.next-profile-description: Applies the next saved profile (wallpaper, lighting and stickers). Needs at least one profile.

onboarding.live-wallpapers-that-light-up-your-room-: Live wallpapers that light up your room and your OS. Let's set the basics — you can change everything later.
onboarding.we'll-apply-your-first-one-now-browse-th: We'll apply your first one now — browse the vault after setup.
onboarding.import-from-the-wallpaper-tab-after-setu: Import from the Wallpaper tab after setup, or keep the current look.
onboarding.fill-the-vault-with-videos-images-or-fol: Fill the vault with videos, images or folders. You can always add more later from the Wallpaper tab.
onboarding.set-one-as-your-wallpaper-now: Set one as your wallpaper now?
onboarding.direct-link-to-an-mp4-webm-video-or-png-: Direct link to an mp4/webm video or png/jpg/webp/gif image (max 200 MB).
onboarding.a-video-or-image-from-your-pc: A video or image from your PC
onboarding.every-video-and-image-inside-in-one-go: Every video and image inside, in one go
onboarding.download-a-wallpaper-from-a-direct-link: Download a wallpaper from a direct link
onboarding.connect-to-openrgb-to-have-your-devices-: Connect to OpenRGB to have your devices follow the wallpaper. No OpenRGB yet? Skip — wallpaper-only is a perfectly good setup.
onboarding.you're-set-devices-will-follow-the-modes: You're set — devices will follow the modes on the next step.
onboarding.start-openrgb-with-the-server-enabled-th: Start OpenRGB with the Server enabled, then retry.
onboarding.pick-how-your-devices-behave-ambient-fol: Pick how your devices behave. Ambient follows the wallpaper — recommended for the full effect.
onboarding.import-a-previous-setup-description: Import a config or profiles file you exported before. A config replaces everything on these screens, so export first if you want to keep what is here.
onboarding.the-toggles-most-people-change-you-can-f: The toggles most people change — you can fine-tune everything in Settings later.
onboarding.true-black-dashboard-in-dark-theme-ideal: True-black dashboard in dark theme — ideal for OLED screens.
onboarding.freeze-the-wallpaper-while-unplugged-rec: Freeze the wallpaper while unplugged (recommended on laptops).
onboarding.taskbar-and-window-highlights-shift-tone: Taskbar and window highlights shift tone with your wallpaper.
onboarding.mirror-wallpaper-stickers-onto-every-dis: Mirror wallpaper stickers onto every display.
onboarding.skip-set-up-later-in-settings: skip — set up later in settings
onboarding.pause-on-fullscreen-description: Stop wallpaper playback while a game or video fills the screen — saves GPU for what you’re doing.
onboarding.profiles-are-one-click-away-from-this-lo: Profiles are one click away from this look — wallpaper, lighting and stickers together. Give this one a name so you can come back to it.
onboarding.profile-name-required: Give your profile a name first
onboarding.here-is-what-we-found: Here is what we found. Fix anything that looks wrong, then continue.
onboarding.no-openrgb-server: OpenRGB is not running, so the lights will stay off
onboarding.no-audio-found: No audio output found, so reactive lighting is unavailable
onboarding.ready-in-under-a-minute: That was the setup. Here is what LumenDeck settled on.
onboarding.still-needs-attention: Almost there. A couple of things still need you.
onboarding.pick-a-thumbnail-to-put-it-on-your-scree: Pick a thumbnail to put it on your screen
onboarding.detection-only-reads-your-machine: This only reads what your machine already reports. Nothing turns on until you say so.
onboarding.audio-reactive-is-offered: Your audio output is there, so audio reactive made the list — the loudest look the app has.
onboarding.amoled-switched-on-for-dark: Switched on because the theme is dark. Turn it off if you prefer a raised panel.
onboarding.requirements-led: One optional program drives your RGB devices. Get it here, or skip it and come back later.
onboarding.openrgb-not-installed: Not installed. LumenDeck works without it — the lights just stay off.
onboarding.requirements-verified: Downloaded from the official OpenRGB releases and checked against its published SHA-256 before anything was unpacked. The portable build is used, so nothing is installed system-wide and no administrator prompt appears.
onboarding.openrgb-running-note: OpenRGB is running with your devices. Your lights will follow the mode you pick next.

nav.lighting-is-disabled-open-the-lighting-t: Lighting is disabled — open the Lighting tab to turn it on
nav.openrgb-is-not-reachable-open-the-lighti: OpenRGB is not reachable — open the Lighting tab
nav.connected-but-no-devices-have-reported-y: Connected, but no devices have reported yet
nav.pushing-colors-to-openrgb-open-the-light: Pushing colors to OpenRGB — open the Lighting tab
nav.every-device-is-black-right-now: Every device is black right now

tray.tooltip-wallpaper-live: LumenDeck — wallpaper is live, lights are off
tray.tooltip-lights-live: LumenDeck — lights are live, wallpaper is off

settings.capture-and-recall-a-whole-look: Capture and recall a whole look
settings.export-profiles-description: Save every profile to one file you can move to another machine. Importing adds them to the ones already here, renaming any whose name is taken.
settings.export-config-description: Save your settings, vault, profiles, playlists and stickers to one file. Use it to move to a new machine, or as a backup.
settings.import-replaces-everything: This replaces everything: your settings, vault, profiles, playlists and stickers will be exactly what the file contains. Export first if you want to keep what is here.
settings.import-adds-these-profiles: This adds these profiles to the ones you already have: {{names}}
settings.import-carries-{n}-media-files: It carries {{n}} of your media files, which will be copied into LumenDeck's library and pointed at from there.
settings.import-carries-no-media-files: It carries no media files. The vault will come back as a list of entries whose files were not included, so import your media again afterwards.
settings.import-{n}-files-were-already-missing: {{n}} file(s) this setup referenced were already missing from the machine it was exported from, and could not be included.

gallery.apply-everywhere-hint: Sets this wallpaper on every display.
gallery.collections-let-you-group-wallpapers-and: Collections group wallpapers so you can switch between whole moods in one click.
gallery.count-includes-missing-files: Some files in this collection are missing
gallery.duplicated-entry-hint: Another entry points at the same file.
gallery.file-is-missing-hint: It was moved or deleted. Applying it does nothing.
gallery.health-hint: A missing file cannot be applied, and a duplicate just takes up room.
gallery.playback-hint: Marked values override the app defaults for this wallpaper only.
gallery.select-all-hint: Selects every wallpaper the current filter shows. Use it again to clear the selection.
gallery.sets-the-newest-of-the-ticked-wallpapers: Sets the newest of the ticked wallpapers. Applying each in turn ends in the same place, with one change per wallpaper on the way there.
gallery.src-browse: Pick one or many videos or images from this computer
gallery.src-folder: Add every image and video in a folder
gallery.src-url: Download a wallpaper from a link
gallery.build-the-index-for-resolution-and-lengt: Build the vault index to show resolution and length.
gallery.pause-in-fullscreen-3d-hint: Stops the wallpaper while a game or 3D app has the screen.
gallery.random-order-next-wallpaper-key: The next-wallpaper key picks any wallpaper, never the one already showing.
gallery.random-order-off-walks-in-order: Off: the next-wallpaper key walks the gallery in order.
gallery.colours-sampled-from-this-picture: The main colours this picture is putting out.
gallery.waiting-for-a-colour-reading: Waiting for the first colour reading.
